# #1646: Patch: Remove cross-menu buttons
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

### What it does

Some artifacts from the menu cleanup are still present. Remove Collection and Shop from the Account menu. Remove Card Creator from the Play menu.

Also, shrink the non-scrollable header for the Stats page since it makes it kind of unusable one mobile. You could cut the highest/lowest winrate boxes.

### Acceptance

The buttons called out above are gone. All other design principles hold.

### Blocked by, part of

_No response_

### Difficulty (a guess)

Not sure (the planner rates it)

### Priority

No priority

### Who does it

Decide later
